His potential candidacy in the 2027 French presidential election, contingent on Marine Le Pen's eligibility, has also been a major topic of discussion. Bardella's personal life, including his relationship with Maria Carolina de Bourbon-Siciles, has further fueled media interest.

His administration's focus on anti-corruption measures, such as the establishment of a National Asset Recovery and Defense Office, has also generated significant media coverage. Magyar's leadership marks a shift in Hungary's political landscape, with his actions shaping the country's domestic and international policies.
